refs: waveform: 9.0-10.6 s is continuously voiced (no pause before أَلَّآ)
notes: qdc tiles the ayah with no gaps, so عَسَىٰٓ's madd munfasil had to be labelled something and it was given to the next word as a second أَلَّآ.
